metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1976 · Rocky
metas.description: A small-time Philadelphia boxer gets a supremely rare chance to fight the world heavyweight champion in a bout in which he strives to go the distance for his self-respect.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1979 · Breaking Away
metas.description: A working-class Indiana teen obsessed with the Italian cycling team vies for the affections of a college girl while searching for life goals with his friends.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1979 · Rocky II
metas.description: Rocky struggles in family life after his bout with Apollo Creed, while the embarrassed champ insistently goads him to accept a challenge for a rematch.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1977 · Pumping Iron
metas.description: Arnold Schwarzenegger and Lou Ferrigno face off in a no-holds-barred competition for the title of Mr. Olympia in this critically-acclaimed film that made Schwarzenegger a household name.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1977 · Slap Shot
metas.description: A failing ice hockey team finds success with outrageously violent hockey goonery.
